name: idea-realization
description: Take an idea from capture through triage, partition, planning, phases and backlog to governed documents, in any git repository.

ideas_path.title: Idea log
ideas_path.description: Append-only idea event log, relative to the repository root.

ideas_view_path.title: Rendered idea view
ideas_view_path.description: Generated Markdown view of the idea log, relative to the repository root.

priority_path.title: Idea priority queue
priority_path.description: Hand-ordered list of idea ids that jump the queue, relative to the repository root.

backlog_path.title: Backlog
backlog_path.description: Phase catalog, relative to the repository root.

docs_root.title: Document root
docs_root.description: Directory holding governed documents, the code register and the systems registry, relative to the repository root.

integration_branch.title: Integration branch
integration_branch.description: Branch that finished work merges into.

worktree_dir.title: Worktree directory
worktree_dir.description: Directory that holds one worktree per session, relative to the repository root. <repository> is replaced by the repository directory's name.

triage_search.title: Triage search list
triage_search.description: Directories and files the triage agent searches for related material, relative to the repository root.

exempt_files.title: Exempt files
exempt_files.description: Markdown files under the document root that carry no front matter, relative to the repository root.

staging_dir.title: Staging directory
staging_dir.description: Gitignored directory for partition drafts and corpora, relative to the repository root.
